notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (FluxFrame Insights) building knowledge search for support & product docs. Started with hosted API eval; POC will exercise embeddings + nightly batch re-index and query-side semantic search. Key ask: predictable throughput during 2-hour nightly index window and consistent p95 search latency for UI. Interested in Dedicated for predictable unit costs and isolation after POC.

Call notes / shorthand: 
- "need predictable throughput for nightly re-index" (CTO)
- Concern: "can't allow customer content to traverse third-party storage; need audit logs + KMS"
- Model prefs: open model variants OK, want Redwood catalog with perf profiles and cheaper quantized variants for bulk embeddings.
- Integration: currently using Postgres + Elastic for metadata; evaluating Pinecone vs Weaviate for vector store. Wants examples of connector patterns and batching best-practices.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market, willing to commit if committed capacity reduces cost by ~30% vs pay-as-you-go. Finance will require 3-year TCO comps vs self-host.
- SE feedback: recommend enabling prefix caching and low-latency routing for lookup API; bulk-embedding pipeline should use batching + retries.

Stated blockers: security sign-off on VPC/KMS, finance TCO, internal timeline clash with Nov major release (limits POC windows).
use_case_summary: Nightly batch embedding of ~50k customer-facing docs, near-real-time indexing during working hours, semantic search for support agents with p95 latency <120ms and tail reliability. Needs vector DB integration guidance, fallback routing when Dedicated capacity saturated, and cost-optimized embedding profiles.
technical_requirements: Target embedding throughput: 25-35/sec sustained during batch window; search throughput: 200 qps with ~10-20 concurrent sessions, p95 <120ms for top-10. Data residency: US-only. SSO: SAML ok. Must support audit logs and KMS-managed keys. Connector: batch jobs export embeddings to Pinecone/Weaviate/S3-backed FAISS pipeline. Prefer automated batching + idempotent resume for failed jobs.
poc_scope: Phase 1 (hosted API): ingest 50k doc corpus, run nightly batch for 3 nights, measure tokens/sec, embedding throughput, index build time, search latencies, and cache hit rate; Phase 2 ( Dedicated eval ): if Phase 1 meets SLOs, run 72-hour dedicated capacity burn to validate throughput and gather committed pricing quote. Deliverables: POC report, performance traces, cost estimate, SLO checklist.
